snippet.title: Prop Revolt – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Prop Revolt on Steam, it enters Early Access on September 30, 2026:
store.steampowered.com/app/5058220/Prop_Revolt/

Being seen is a resource.

Prop Revolt is an asymmetric multiplayer hide-and-seek game for 2–10 players. Blend in as an ordinary object, outlast the Hunters, and try to stay calm when their attention lands on you.

Getting watched raises your Nervousness, but it also builds a shared Revolt charge for every surviving Prop. Once the charge is ready, activate the Revolt and strike back together for a limited time. Ram Hunters while disguised or fight on foot after being exposed.

Your chosen object defines how you play: compact Props are quick and easy to conceal, while larger objects are tougher and far more dangerous when the Revolt begins.

FEATURES

• Online and LAN multiplayer for 2–10 players
• A shared Nervousness and Revolt system
• Four Prop size classes with different strengths
• Four Hunter weapons, armour, and level pickups
• Three maps available at Early Access launch
• Modular Robot and Hunter customization

Prop Revolt enters Early Access on September 30, 2026.

Official website:
proprevolt.com

Join the Discord:
discord.gg/8BzF8ygDaH

This trailer was captured from an early build and represents work in progress. Visuals and gameplay may and will change before release.

Developed and published by Faesslich Digital.

#PropRevolt #PropHunt #indiegame
